nvitk.registration
==================

.. py:module:: nvitk.registration

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Medical image registration helpers (FSL + optional ANTsPy / FireANTs).

.. py:function:: flirt_apply_rigid(in_file: str | pathlib.Path, reference: str | pathlib.Path, mat_file: str | pathlib.Path, out_file: str | pathlib.Path, *, interp: str = 'trilinear') -> pathlib.Path

   Apply an existing FLIRT ``*.mat`` transform (``-applyxfm``).


.. py:function:: flirt_register_rigid(moving: str | pathlib.Path, fixed: str | pathlib.Path, out_dir: str | pathlib.Path, *, dof: int = 6, cost: str = 'corratio', warped_name: str = 'moving_warped.nii.gz', matrix_name: str = 'affine.mat', searchr_x: float | None = None) -> FlirtRigidResult

   Run FLIRT rigid alignment of *moving* towards *fixed* reference image.

   Writes ``matrix_name`` under *out_dir* and optionally a warped moving image.
   Requires FSL on ``PATH`` and ``FSLDIR`` set (NiPype delegates to ``flirt``).


.. py:class:: FlirtRigidResult

   Paths and NiPype runtime from a FLIRT rigid run.


   .. py:attribute:: matrix_path
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:attribute:: warped_path
      :type:  pathlib.Path | None


   .. py:attribute:: runtime
      :type:  Any


.. py:class:: AntsRegistrationResult

   Paths produced by an ANTs registration: warped moving image and forward/inverse transforms.


   .. py:attribute:: warped_moving_path
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:attribute:: fwd_transforms
      :type:  tuple[pathlib.Path, Ellipsis]


   .. py:attribute:: inv_transforms
      :type:  tuple[pathlib.Path, Ellipsis]


   .. py:attribute:: out_prefix
      :type:  str


.. py:function:: ants_apply(*, fixed_path: pathlib.Path, moving_path: pathlib.Path, out_path: pathlib.Path, transforms: list[pathlib.Path], interpolator: str = 'linear', whichtoinvert: list[bool] | None = None, verbose: bool = False) -> pathlib.Path

   Apply transforms to map MOVING into FIXED space.


.. py:function:: ants_register(*, fixed_path: pathlib.Path, moving_path: pathlib.Path, out_dir: pathlib.Path, type_of_transform: str = 'SyN', write_composite_transform: bool = False, verbose: bool = False) -> AntsRegistrationResult

   Register MOVING to FIXED and write outputs under *out_dir*.


.. py:class:: FireAntsResult

   Outputs produced by `fireantsRegistration`.


   .. py:attribute:: output_prefix
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:attribute:: warped_moving_path
      :type:  pathlib.Path


.. py:function:: fireants_apply(*, fixed_path: pathlib.Path, moving_path: pathlib.Path, out_path: pathlib.Path, transforms: list[pathlib.Path]) -> pathlib.Path

   Apply FireANTs transforms if `fireantsApplyTransforms` is available.


.. py:function:: fireants_register(*, fixed_path: pathlib.Path, moving_path: pathlib.Path, out_dir: pathlib.Path, device: str = 'cuda:0', verbose: bool = False) -> FireAntsResult

   Run a default multi-stage FireANTs registration (Rigid→Affine→SyN).
